title: When saving a scene or exporting a project, external nodes in a non-editable scene instance may be silently lost
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
- `4.7.2-stable`
- `4.8.dev4.official.b56a91878`

### System information

Windows 10 (build 19045)

### Issue description

> Refiled per maintainer's request in #123172; original text written by me, machine-translated.

When saving a scene or exporting a project, some scene nodes may be lost under certain circumstances. This can happen even though the project previously loaded and ran normally within the Godot editor itself. The loss occurs without any warnings.

Upon investigating the issue, it was discovered that `PackedScene::pack()` silently discards nodes that belong to an external scene but are placed inside a scene instance that is not marked with the `editable` tag, under its internal nodes, deeper than the instance root. Direct child nodes of the instance are not discarded. This can happen not only during manual scene edits, but also during Git merges or when using other third-party tools or agents.

The main reason is that when a scene is loaded in text format, all nodes from the list are created as-is, but when saving, `SceneState::_parse_node()` during `pack()` does not reach these nodes, and they are discarded. Consequently, when saving a `.tscn` file, exporting with conversion to a binary `.scn` file, or making any other call to `PackedScene.pack()`—including at runtime (#90823)—these nodes are silently lost.

### Steps to reproduce

#### 1. Unzip the MRP and launch the project

```sh
cd mrp_pack_drops_nodes
godot --headless --path .
```

Expected output: `RESULT inside_found=true direct_found=true`

#### 2. Export with scene conversion to binary format enabled

```sh
godot --headless --path . --export-pack "Web" test.pck
```

#### 3. Run the exported pack

```sh
godot --headless --main-pack test.pck
```

Expected output: `RESULT inside_found=false direct_found=true` - the `InsideLabel` node is missing.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp_pack_drops_nodes.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31850438/mrp_pack_drops_nodes.zip)
